title: 第11章 广成赤精强夺宝水火麒麟显神通第12章 赤精痛失阴阳镜多宝痛殴广成子
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
正当多宝道人沉浸在对林镜手中九九散魄葫芦的细致观察中，心中默念着关于这件传说中鸿蒙灵根产物的种种神奇之处！
一个突兀而挑衅的声音划破了空气，犹如晴天霹雳一般震响在他的耳畔：
““这位道友，你拿着我的法宝做什么？””
多宝道人皱眉抬头，心中虽有一丝不快，却也不免有些惊讶。
要知道，他身为截教大师兄，威名赫赫，鲜有人敢于在他面前放肆。然而，眼前的状况显然超出了他的预料，居然真的有人敢在他眼皮底下觊觎这件刚刚现身的极品先天灵宝。
多宝道人无奈地摇摇头，原本沉浸在研究九九散魄葫芦的乐趣中，此刻不得不暂时放下手中的宝贝，面对这突如其来的挑战。
毕竟传说中的鸿蒙灵根葫芦藤所结出每一个先天葫芦都是独一无二的极品先天灵宝，有人想要冒险也情有可原，可惜这次踢到铁板了！
与此同时，高空中，广成子与赤精子也在第一时间注意到了地面的情况。他们本是循着九九散魄葫芦爆发的气息而来，未曾料想到竟然会遭遇这样的变故。
两位仙长交换了一个意味深长的眼神，心中各有盘算。广成子微微颔首，示意先观察一番局势发展；而赤精子则紧握双拳，跃跃欲试，似乎已做好了介入争端的准备。
多宝道人直接转身怒喝道：
“什么人？抢法宝都抢到我多宝道人的头上来了？”
半空之中，原本注意力都在九九散魄葫芦和林镜的两人，这时才发现了多宝道人的存在！
原本准备直接出手抢夺的广成子也只好停下动作，
朗声开口道：
“原来是多宝道友啊，在下乃是阐教元始天尊座下广成子！这九九散魄葫芦乃是我阐教所有，还是请这位小道友交还于我！”
自从三清分家之后，阐教和截教因为理念不合，基本上很少往来！
而阐教众人因为收到了元始天尊的理念所影响，根本看不起截教这些披毛戴角之人，湿生卵化之辈！
昆仑十二金仙，其中黄龙真人就是如此，正因出身鳞甲之属，颇不得师尊元始天尊青睐。
现在两人眼见灵宝在林镜的手中，肯定是起了抢夺之心了！
多宝道人咧嘴一笑，这阐教的人还是一如既往的不要脸，觉得什么好东西都应该是他们的！

“哼！九九散魄葫芦乃是昔年红云道人的灵宝，洪荒皆知，什么时候成了你们阐教的了？”
赤精子的眼眸扫过广成子，立即心领神会的开口说道：
“这九九散魄葫芦被我师尊隐藏至今，一直在此地沉睡修复残缺！如今师尊觉得是时候了，这才命令我两人前来取宝，怎么？多宝道友是打算强行扣下我阐教至宝吗？”
这可是极品先天灵宝，整个洪荒也没有多少件的灵宝！
如果能够把这件灵宝带回阐教，肯定能够得到元始天尊的称赞！
如此看来，现在随便说点谎言就无伤大雅了！
原本眼见阐教的两位金仙想要抢夺灵宝，多宝道人早就跃跃欲试准备出手了！
他现在的实力，即使是以一敌二也不在话下！
可是经过赤精子这么一解释，似乎的确有些合理！
这要是因为一件极品先天至宝就得罪了圣人，的确有些得不偿失啊！
广成子与赤精子两人对视一眼，看着已经陷入犹豫之中的多宝道人，再次添油加醋道：
“红花、莲藕、青荷叶，三教本是一家！多宝师兄应该明白，不会因为贪图一件灵宝，让二教产生嫌隙吧？”
多宝道人的目光转向林镜，要是这法宝是自己发现的，那实在不行放弃就算了！
可是这九九散魄葫芦乃是林镜的发现啊，要是让师弟受委屈的话，那还要他这个师兄做什么？
林镜这时也看穿了空中两人的计谋，不过是狐假虎威罢了！
这混沌乱流明显不是圣人所为，他们不过想先把九九散魄葫芦骗到手，等到时候回了阐教还不是随意编造！
“多宝师兄，不必相信，他们俩是在骗你的！”
多宝道人闻言顿时心中郁闷一扫而空，转而向着两人怒目而视！
师弟既然说是在骗人，那就肯定是在骗人，就算是玉清圣人元始天尊亲自来了那也是在骗人！
然而眼看已经要相信的多宝道人被那位青年人一句话就策反了，广成子与赤精子顿时喝到：

“大胆小贼！胆敢图谋我阐教至宝？圣人之言岂是你能够妄加议论的！”
多宝道人将林镜护在身后，目光中透露出阵阵杀意！
content_en:
Just as Taoist Duobao was immersed in the detailed observation of the Nine-Nine Sanso Gourd in Lin Jing's hand, he was silently thinking about the magical features of this legendary product of Hongmeng spiritual root!
A sudden and provocative voice pierced the air, ringing in his ears like a thunderbolt from the blue:
""Fellow Taoist, what are you doing with my magic weapon? ""
Taoist Duobao frowned and raised his head. Although he was a little unhappy, he was also a little surprised.
You know, as the senior brother of Jie Jiao, he has a great reputation, and few people dare to be presumptuous in front of him. However, the situation in front of him was obviously beyond his expectation. Someone actually dared to covet this top-quality innate spiritual treasure that had just appeared under his nose.
Taoist Duobao shook his head helplessly. He was originally immersed in the fun of studying the Jiujiu Sanso Gourd. At this moment, he had to put down the treasure in his hands temporarily to face this sudden challenge.
After all, every innate gourd produced by the legendary Hongmeng Spiritual Root Gourd Vine is a unique and top-grade innate spiritual treasure. It is understandable that some people want to take risks, but it is a pity that they hit the iron plate this time!
At the same time, high in the air, Guangchengzi and Akejie noticed the situation on the ground for the first time. They originally came following the aura of the Nine-Nine Soul Gourd's explosion, but they never expected to encounter such a change.
The two immortals exchanged meaningful glances, each with their own plans in mind. Guangchengzi nodded slightly, indicating that he would observe the development of the situation first; while Akejie clenched his fists, eager to try, and seemed to be ready to intervene in the dispute.
Taoist Duobao turned around and shouted angrily:
"Who is it? Are they trying to steal the magic weapon on my head, Taoist Duobao?"
In mid-air, the two people who originally focused on Jiujiu Sanpo Gourd and Lin Jing discovered the existence of Taoist Duobao!
Guangchengzi, who was originally planning to snatch it directly, had no choice but to stop.
He spoke loudly:
"It turns out to be fellow Taoist Duobao. This is Guangchengzi, the disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun of Chanjiao! This Jiujiu Sanpo gourd belongs to me, Taoist monk, so please give it back to me, fellow Taoist!"
Since the separation of the Sanqing family, Chanjiao and Jiejiao have basically had little contact because of their different ideas!
However, because everyone in the Chan Sect was influenced by Yuanshi Tianzun's ideas, they looked down on the Jie Jiao, these people with hair and horns, who were born from moisture and turned into eggs!
Among the Twelve Golden Immortals of Kunlun, Huanglong Zhenren is like this. Because he was born in the genus of Scale Armor, he is not favored by Master Yuanshi Tianzun.
Now that the two of them saw the Lingbao in Lin Jing's hands, they must have wanted to snatch it!
Taoist Duobao grinned. The people who explained the teaching were still as shameless as ever, thinking that all good things should be theirs!
"Hmph! The Jiujiu Sanpo Gourd is the spiritual treasure of Hongyun Taoist in the past. Everyone knows it. When did it become your teaching?"
Aka Seiko's eyes swept over Guangchengzi, and he immediately spoke with understanding:
"This Nine-nine Soul Gourd has been hidden by my master till now. It has been sleeping here to repair the damage! Now the master thinks it is time, so he ordered the two of me to come and get the treasure. What? Is Fellow Taoist Duobao planning to forcibly seize the treasure of my teaching?"
This is the best innate spiritual treasure, and there are not many spiritual treasures in the entire prehistoric era!
If you can bring this spiritual treasure back to Chanjiao, you will definitely be praised by Yuanshi Tianzun!
It seems that there is no harm in telling lies now!
Originally, when he saw the two golden immortals from Chanjiao trying to snatch the spiritual treasure, Taoist Duobao was already eager to take action!
His current strength is no problem even if he is one against two!
But after Chi Jing’s explanation, it does seem reasonable!
If this is to offend a saint because of a top-quality innate treasure, it is indeed a bit more gain than loss!
Guangchengzi and Chi Jingzhi looked at each other, looked at Taoist Duobao who was already hesitating, and added jealously again:
“Red flowers, lotus roots, and green lotus leaves, the three teachings are originally one.Home! Senior Brother Duobao should understand that he won't cause discord between the two religions just because he is greedy for a spiritual treasure, right? "
Taoist Duobao turned his attention to Lin Jing. If he discovered this magic weapon by himself, then he would just give up if he couldn't!
But this Jiujiu Soul Gourd was discovered by Lin Jing. If his junior brother was wronged, what else would he do?
Lin Jing also saw through the plan of the two people in the air at this time, it was just a fox pretending to be a tiger!
This chaotic flow was obviously not the work of a saint. They just wanted to deceive the Jiujiu Sanso Gourd first, and when the time came to return to Chanjiao, they would not just make it up at will!
"Senior Brother Duobao, don't believe it, they are lying to you! "
When Taoist Duobao heard this, his depression suddenly disappeared, and he turned to glare at the two of them!
Since junior brother said he was lying, he must be lying. Even if the Yuqing Saint Yuanshi Tianzun came in person, he would still be lying!
However, Taoist Duobao, who was about to believe it, was instigated by the young man to rebel with just one word. Guangchengzi and Chi Jingjie immediately drank:
"Bold little thief! Dare you plot against me to explain my teachings? How can you arbitrarily discuss the words of a saint? "
Taoist Duobao protected Lin Jing behind him, with murderous intent in his eyes!
